skill_cj_batch_list_and_export.name: CJ Dropshipping Batch Sourcing & Mass Export
skill_cj_batch_list_and_export.description: Switches CJ search to List view, checks select-all for up to 200 items, and mass adds them to your CJ account or triggers multi-thousand item CSV exports.
steps: 1. In CJ Dropshipping product search, toggle to 'List' view in the upper right.
2. Click the 'Select All' checkbox in the dark table header bar to check all 60–200 items.
3. Click the orange 'Selected Items: X/200' button in the upper right.
4. In the batch management modal, click 'All Products' at the bottom.
5. Choose 'Add To My Products' (to associate to your CJ account) or 'Export' (to download full CSV/Excel spreadsheet).

skill_realtime_margin_optimization.name: Autonomous Margin & Pricing Optimizer
skill_realtime_margin_optimization.description: Scans all 205 products in the catalog database, verifies supplier costs, enforces a strict 60–75% gross profit margin, and computes retail compare-at prices for Best Buy savings badges.
steps: 2. Read all products and evaluate cost_price vs retail price.
3. Ensure minimum 60% gross profit margin: target_price = cost_price / (1 - target_margin).
4. Calculate compare_at_price (target_price * 1.30) to provide attractive savings badges.
5. Update database records and persist changes.

skill_mass_catalog_csv_export.name: Multi-Channel Catalog & Whop Manifest Generator
skill_mass_catalog_csv_export.description: Generates clean CSV and JSON data exports for Whop bulk import, CJ dropshipping logistics mapping, and Shopify/WooCommerce cross-channel feeds.
steps: 1. Query all active physical products from nyxeris.db.
2. Map authentic titles, real supplier URLs, CJ SKUs, retail pricing, and CDN image links.

skill_whop_copywriting_and_sync.name: Whop Architectural Luxury Copywriting & Listing
skill_whop_copywriting_and_sync.description: Leverages Titan-One to generate studio-grade, minimalist product copy with zero dropshipping mentions, and publishes products to Whop company biz_ea3gy6pg50A7px.
steps: 1. Inspect raw supplier product specifications and photos.
2. Run Titan-One brand filter to strip generic spam keywords.
3. Format into architectural specifications, feature bullets, and unboxing details.
4. Publish to Whop company using session cookies or Whop product creation API.
